column2: Quality borders, quest marks, item level, BoE text, set names and dimmed junk
Group the bank by category, with a sidebar
With Enable Bags off, the default bag functions are no longer replaced, avoiding blocked action errors from tainted bag code.
Opening the Characters list no longer errors.
Gold sale ads with websites or cash prices, including 5000G=20 bucks and disguised W.W.W addresses, are filtered by default in your selected chat scopes.
Unsupported server channel notices such as NOT_IN_LFG no longer cause the native chat formatter to error.
Optional spam filtering with a repeat window, sender matching and public, group or whisper controls.
Background, divider, input position, Retail border and tabs over the native dock, plus a sidebar with friends, guild, copy, channels and settings.
Retail timestamps, short channel names, class colored names, link tooltips, whisper sounds, saved chat history and Retail URL and copy windows.
Show Hidden Messages lists the last 200 lines the spam filter hid this session, with time, reason, channel and sender. Clear Filter History is now Reset Repeat Memory.
The trade ad preset also hides LFW (looking for work) crafting ads.
Right-click the chat in Unlock Mode to open its Display settings
Restyled chat bubbles with per-channel toggles and hiding in instances
The chat fades after a delay and comes back on mouseover
Copy Chat copies the chat tab you are looking at instead of the last tab you right-clicked, which could show \"(No chat history)\".
Fixed a \"SetPoint(): is dependent on this\" error when styling some NPC chat bubbles.
The guild recruitment filter no longer hides raid ads that mention a guild, such as \"<Frost> LF 1 heal ICC25\"; only LF guild phrases count.
GM whispers and messages are never hidden by the spam filter.
Spam filter keywords ignore case for accented letters too, so promoção also hides PROMOÇÃO.
The trade ad and guild recruitment filters follow the Public Chat setting, and the spam filter does no work while every filter is off.
The sidebar shows on first load, and tabs and toggles update right away.
The main chat keeps its Unlock Mode position instead of being reset by the dock.
A saved chat opacity of 0 resets once to the Retail default.
Square, rectangular, circle and textured circle maps, with border size, opacity, textured styles and custom, accent or class colors.
Addon buttons collect into the Retail flyout with a grid, grow direction and Shift-drag Free Move.
A vanilla ring and zone banner with native zoom buttons
Clock and zone boxes in ten positions, plus coordinates, FPS and latency, and difficulty text
Guild and friends at a glance; left-click whispers, right-click invites
Menu actions open Blizzard windows through secure calls, avoiding blocked action errors.
Pick Classic WoW UI for Damage Meters on the Style page: each window gets the classic tooltip border, a tooltip header band and vanilla header icons, and keeps every EllesmereUI meter feature.
A spell's breakdown tooltip shows its Spell ID, and each spell row in the detailed window ends with its ID.
Consumed shield absorbs count toward Healing Done and HPS when the caster can be identified, with an Absorbs Done view.
Flat body, accent header, Atrocity bars and header icons for Settings, Segment, Meter Type and Reset, with up to five windows.
Up to 15 spells and the top three targets on hover, death recaps with health at each hit, and a per-player focus view.
SharedMedia bar textures load whether a profile stores them in Damage Meters or EllesmereUI format
An icon strip and bar window of your casts, including failed and interrupted ones
A standalone combat timer with its own Unlock Mode element
Windows snap to each other; locked windows cannot move, resize or close
Keybinds for Reset Data and Show / Hide Windows
Specialization icons from talent data and paced group inspection
Load an action menu only in your primary or secondary talent group, and let two menus share one keybind across specs.
Hold a key, point or scroll to choose, release to fire. Up to 16 palettes of 20 entries in ring, arc, fan or grid layouts.
An Action Menu entry fans out up to 8 actions from another palette, one level out from the ring.
Accent, class or custom color for the selected entry, needle and nested highlight
Set the gap between a nested menu and its entry, and the nested icon size
Reverse which way a wheel tick moves the selection
Assign Key captures the next key with modifiers and asks before rebinding
Keep the menu open on release and fire with a Select key
Red when out of range, blue when short of power, grey when unusable
